name: Jipal Hi-Tech
india_angle: Jipal has localized presence in India, indicating a strategic focus on the Indian market.
summary: Jipal Hi-Tech is a distributor specializing in semiconductor packaging and testing equipment, as well as PCBA related materials. With a strong presence across Asia, including India, the company offers customer-centric solutions and comprehensive post-sales support, catering to advanced packaging and test & measurement segments.
